verdict.rationale: GitHub's own Copilot page says individual subscribers can opt out of having their data used for AI model training at any time, so the core capability exists. The evidence covers only individual subscribers, which leaves an engineering lead's team- or org-level control unevidenced. Community skepticism about enterprise training use is not a concrete counter-example and does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: documented org/enterprise-level opt-out or policy control, explicit mention that code and prompts specifically are covered, in-depth docs on how the opt-out works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training

citations.quote: Individual subscribers can opt out of having their data used for AI model training at any time
